title: LIVING FOR JESUS
stanzas: Living For Jesus a life that is true, Striving to please Him in all that you do, Yielding allegiance, glad-hearted and free, This is the pathway of blessing for me.
Living for Jesus who died in my place bearing on Calv'ry my sin and disgrace; Such love constraints me to answer His call, Following His leading and giving Him all.
Living for Jesus thro' earth's little while, My dearest treasure, the light if His smile, seeking the lost ones He died to redeem, Bringing the weary to find rest in Him.
chorus: O Jesus, Lord and savior, I give myself to Thee; For Thou, in The atonement, Didst give Thyself for me; I own no other master, My heart shall be Thy throne, My life I give, henceforth to live., O Christ for Thee alone
